price.per_unit: ADS together with one Series A Warrant and one Series B Warrant

components.scenario: Up to the stated quantity in a reasonable best efforts offering. Each ADS must be purchased with one Series A Warrant and one Series B Warrant, issued separately and immediately separable. Each Pre-Funded Warrant sold reduces the ADSs offered one-for-one.

quantity.unit: ADSs initially purchasable under Series A Warrants

components.scenario: Warrants initially to purchase up to the stated quantity of ADSs; one accompanies each ADS or Pre-Funded Warrant sold. The combined ADS-and-warrants price is recorded in c1. Exercisable from issuance for five years, with exercise-price and underlying-ADS quantity adjustments.

quantity.unit: ADSs initially purchasable under Series B Warrants

components.scenario: Warrants initially to purchase up to the stated quantity of ADSs; one accompanies each ADS or Pre-Funded Warrant sold. The combined ADS-and-warrants price is recorded in c1. Term is two and one-half years from issuance, subject to exercise restrictions, exercise-price and quantity adjustments, and a zero exercise price option subject to the Mandatory Nominal Exercise Price.

price.per_unit: Pre-Funded Warrant together with one Series A Warrant and one Series B Warrant

components.scenario: Up to the stated quantity in lieu of ADSs for purchasers exceeding the 4.99% beneficial ownership limit, or 9.99% at their election. Each Pre-Funded Warrant purchases one ADS and reduces ADSs offered one-for-one. The combined purchase price equals the ADS-and-accompanying-warrants price minus the USD equivalent of GBP 0.01 at the pricing-date exchange rate.

components.security_label: American Depositary Shares Underlying the Series A Warrants, the Series B Warrants (which Series B Warrants contain a “zero exercise price” option) and the Pre-Funded Warrants
components.scenario: Up to the stated aggregate quantity registered for issuance upon exercise of c2, c3 and c4, including warrant adjustments and the Series B zero exercise price option. These underlying ADSs represent up to 13,981,878,225 ordinary shares.

post_offering_os.scenario: After this offering, assuming no Pre-Funded Warrants are issued and no Warrants are exercised; each ADS represents twenty-five ordinary shares.

Immediately after this offering, including ordinary shares represented by ADSs, assuming no Pre-Funded Warrants are issued and no Warrants are exercised. The stated calculation excludes outstanding equity-compensation options and 29,123 ordinary shares issued upon option exercises subsequent to December 31, 2024.

proceeds.scenario: Approximately, assuming all offered securities are sold at the assumed combined price of USD 0.5601 per ADS and accompanying Warrants, after Placement Agent fees and estimated offering expenses, with no Pre-Funded Warrants sold and no Warrants exercised.
